765-2645-2930-3430.easyPrerequisites: Portent Tracker doesn't have summoning sickness.
765-2645-2930-3430.description:
Activate Guildless Commons by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping Guildless Commons
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Portent Tracker.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1021-5414-6303-6664.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, preventing the next 2 damage dealt to a target this turn.
Repeat.

567-4499-8160.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Zombie Creature castable for one colored mana

728-3249-5268-7968--206.easyPrerequisites:
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
728-3249-5268-7968--206.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the zombie castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the zombie castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that zombie spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that zombie or when it enters, Diregraf Colossus triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1089-7863--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1089-7863--165.description:
Draw a card.
Human Torch triggers, dealing 1 damage.
Curiosity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-1115-3899.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1115-3899.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2111-5226-6982.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1251-2411-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-2411-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Lathril, triggering Breath of Fury and Lathril.
Resolve the Lathril trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Blitzwing, Cruel Tormentor // Blitzwing, Adaptive Assailant

5008-7276.manaNeeded: {W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable if Dark Leo & Shredder isn't on the battlefield
5008-7276.easyPrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block Dark Leo & Shredder if it's on the battlefield, or another creature you control otherwise.
Dark Leo & Shredder doesn't have summoning sickness if it's on the battlefield.
You control at least four Ninjas.
5008-7276.description:
Declare Dark Leo & Shredder as an attacker if it's on the battlefield, or another creature you control otherwise.
If Dark Leo & Shredder isn't on the battlefield, when the declared creature is unblocked, cast Dark Leo & Shredder either from your hand or from the command zone for its sneak cost by paying {W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable and returning the unblocked attacker to your hand.
Deal combat damage using Dark Leo & Shredder, triggering its second ability, creating a 1/1 Ninja creature token and causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Blitzwing triggers, causing the opponent to lose the rest of their life total.
5008-7276.notes: You must control four Ninjas when Dark Leo & Shredder deals combat damage. Notably, if it isn't on the battlefield, you must control five total Ninjas if the attacker you will be returning is a Ninja.

1734-4605-5147-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Fiend Hunter and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1013-7124.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Incredible Hulk.
1013-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate The Incredible Hulk by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to it.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, untapping it and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

969-5475-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2757-3525-6857.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Kragma Butcher, untapping the Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Kragma Butcher.
Kragma Butcher triggers, giving it +2/+0 until end of turn
Repeat.

944-4484-4871-5643-6798.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
944-4484-4871-5643-6798.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Umbral Collar Zealot abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
944-4484-4871-5643-6798.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

5437-5742-5743-6753.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Prognostic Sphinx ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2457-3499-4289-4365.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

215-2506-2743.description:
Cast Biovisionary by paying {1}{G}{U}.
When Biovisionary enters the battlefield, Molten Echoes triggers, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning the nontoken Biovisionary from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time, and then repeat steps 1 and 2 one additional time.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

254-4659-5003-6554.manaNeeded: {1}{R} plus {2} if Mister Gutsy doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it
254-4659-5003-6554.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{G}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mister Gutsy, adding {C}{C}.
When Mister Gutsy dies, its second ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Mister Gutsy trigger, creating a number of Junk tokens equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on it.
If you created a Junk token, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Junk, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Mister Gutsy from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Mister Gutsy enters the battlefield, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mister Gutsy.
Repeat from step 2.

813-957-3603.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, taking two extra turns.
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch and Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each other turn.
813-957-3603.notes: If desired, you can do steps 2 and 3 during the first extra turn instead to spread out the mana costs.

2034-4321-5777.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
2034-4321-5777.description:
Activate Camellia by paying {2} and sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Camellia ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Squirrel token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1453-1636-3143.notablePrerequisites:
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one nonlegendary creature token.
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
1453-1636-3143.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a copy of a creature token you control that enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1385-4186-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
1385-4186-4279.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Repeat from step 7.

575-3510-4726.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Saproling and/or creature with changeling.
575-3510-4726.description:
Activate Thallid Germinator's second ability by sacrificing a nontoken Saproling or creature with changeling, targeting any creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land and as a 1/1 Saproling due to Life and Limb.
Resolve the Thallid Germinator ability, giving target creature +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1692-1950-1965.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a colorless creature you control.
1692-1950-1965.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Omarthis with haste.
Put a +1/+1 counter on the Omarthis token or another colorless creature you control.
The nontoken Omarthis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
The Omarthis token triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 3.

1322-1409-2661.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Gwenna.
1322-1409-2661.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Activate Gwenna by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Gwenna enters the battlefield, Deadeye Navigator's soulbound ability triggers, repairing it and Gwenna.
Repeat.

369-4775-5256.notablePrerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-4775-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Iridescent Drake's power.
Repeat.

2773-5191.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Raptor Hatchling indestructible.
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield or to deal damage to Raptor Hatchling.
2773-5191.description:
Give Raptor Hatchling indestructible by any method.
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield.
When it enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers, causing that creature to deal damage to your indestructible Raptor Hatchling.
Raptor Hatchling triggers, creating a 3/3 green Dinosaur creature token with trample.
Warstorm Surge triggers, causing the Dinosaur token to deal 3 damage to the indestructible Raptor Hatchling.
Repeat from step 4.
